name: 01852 · Lowell, MA
findings: ZIP 01852 (Lowell) has 144 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01852 (Lowell) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01852 (Lowell) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.
